laneRangeScreen.scope: Every float32 value in the recorded final lane bucket for gate8 and gate10, changed one runner at a time at its last baseline lane movement. Each candidate receives a full race simulation.
laneRangeScreen.limits: Artificial changes to one runner lane at its last baseline lane movement; two-runner changes and different earlier position/world histories are outside this screen. No new mechanic or official hidden state is established.

limits: All candidates start from the baseline position and previous-world state at the last observed simulator lane movement.
The lane is then held constant. Hidden official lane movements within a replay bucket are not excluded.
Movement speed is frozen to the baseline schedule. The later blocking cap reacts to position; post-block exclusions are conditional.

findings: All 9,123 clear decisions and 8,901 target lists reproduce from logged simulator state. All 7,062 crowd edges and generated candidate lanes also reproduce.

No rejected corridor or overtaking eligibility comparison for the four focused gates is within eight float32 steps of its relevant boundary. The nearest blocker margin is 100 lane float32 steps at gate 7, 35.165 s; another blocker independently rejects that corridor.

Cached/live position or lane substitutions alter some local corridor decisions only before 23.4433 s. No such substitutions change focused corridor acceptance during 30–35.2 s. These are local snapshot contrasts, not alternative race simulations.

The broader visibility/front/side/crowd screen finds 72 near-boundary comparison records, all during 0.0666–3.1302 s. These comprise nine visibility records involving ineligible targets and 63 side-permission records.

Sixty-two near side-permission records have another blocker in the same direction. The sole remaining record is outward permission for gate 11 at 2.1978 s; target and visible lists are empty, no passing search runs, and the runner holds its lane.

One visibility reconstruction differs when using the later target context: gate 6 at 13.58638 s, vision 20. Reconstructing with the preceding vision 33.5 exactly matches the cached visible list. This is consistent with the designed pre-update cache versus live-context transition; neither list supplies an eligible target there.
No tested margin or state contrast identifies a justified engine change.
limits: Reproducing simulator state does not establish official hidden-state correctness.
Counts are logged comparison records, including repeated comparisons across ticks and candidate paths, not unique independent boundaries.
Eight float steps is a diagnostic screen, not a validation tolerance or proof that larger upstream differences are impossible.
Early near-boundary cases were analyzed for relevance, not mutated or rerun.
The recorded baseline ends at 35.165 s; subsequent logged calls up to 730 m remain outside the timestamp-focused screen.

geometryAndRecording.interpretation: The optimization reproduces the older source at all traced states; exact raw replay positions match expected. These comparisons do not establish official hidden-state geometry.

skillExpiry.interpretation: The trace shows timely target-bonus removal. Source review found no missing dependency in the base-acceleration cache; no engine correction was established.

nextEvidence: An independent full-tick reference for the unchanged exact lobby and seed would expose hidden lane/world/movement state. No per-race exception or tolerance change is supported.

boundedReferences.selection: 100 closest per-sub-batch race numbers to 102; race numbers repeat across six sub-batches, so this is a bounded same-batch sample rather than a contiguous time window.

nearbyOfficialControls.conclusion: No independent identical-seed or exact-input replay was found in the searched collected indexes. Nine same-course nearby controls share all 16 runner builds after ignoring gates and popularity, and all pass the strict audit; gate order differs in all nine, and some tied popularity assignments also differ. These controls do not resolve the target discrepancy.
limitations: Exact-lobby reference comparisons were limited to 100 selected races in the original batch, not all 595279 corpus references.
Archived inventories lack seed fields for some or all rows; no raw archived references were scanned.
No new simulation, collection, registry, quarantine, original-data, or engine changes were performed.
The live metrics main database was not used: read-only open required journal recovery. A read-only cycle-index query found only the original seed record among 69876 indexed races.
